positive_controls.name: independent_sigmoid_additive_fm
positive_controls.architecture: independent additive and FM algorithms joined by an externally imposed sigmoid interpolation

positive_controls.name: independent_sigmoid_modal_noise
positive_controls.architecture: independent modal resonator and stochastic-noise algorithms joined by an externally imposed sigmoid interpolation

negative_controls.name: single_engine_continuous_fm
negative_controls.architecture: one FM algorithm whose modulation index and ratio vary smoothly with alpha; no engine or chart switch is present

negative_controls.name: single_engine_continuous_additive
negative_controls.architecture: one additive algorithm whose spectral tilt and inharmonicity vary smoothly with alpha; no engine or chart switch is present

success_criteria.positive_requirement: frozen-rule peak must lie within 0.05 of each positive control's preregistered ground-truth transition center
success_criteria.negative_requirement: negative controls must not show a transition peak prominence greater than 3.0 times their median transition score
success_criteria.overall_pass: both positive controls pass ground-truth location tolerance and both negative controls pass the no-concentrated-transition requirement

interpretation_boundary: Passing this suite would show transfer beyond the reconstructed OMNARIA handoff schedule, but would still not establish a universal synthesis law.
